name: @odk/shell
description: Open DeskOS Electron Shell for Linux, Windows, and macOS; CM5 reference panel

scripts.styles: node scripts/build-onee-avatar.mjs && node scripts/build-liquid-glass.mjs && unocss "src/renderer/**/*.html" "src/renderer/**/*.js" "!src/renderer/themes/liquid-glass-sdk.js" "!src/renderer/avatars/onee-sdk.js" -c uno.config.mjs -o src/renderer/uno.css --minify
scripts.styles:watch: node scripts/build-onee-avatar.mjs && node scripts/build-liquid-glass.mjs && unocss "src/renderer/**/*.html" "src/renderer/**/*.js" "!src/renderer/themes/liquid-glass-sdk.js" "!src/renderer/avatars/onee-sdk.js" -c uno.config.mjs -o src/renderer/uno.css --watch
scripts.preflight: pnpm test && pnpm styles && pnpm verify-release
scripts.geometry: pnpm styles && electron tests/status-bar-style.cjs && electron tests/home-handle.cjs && electron tests/agent-home.cjs --agent-reference-only && electron tests/agent-home.cjs --onee-flow-only && electron tests/responsive-matrix.cjs && electron tests/home-preview.cjs --widget-grid && electron tests/widget-density.cjs && electron tests/pi-tile-style.cjs && electron tests/futu-style.cjs && electron tests/input-scroll-polish.cjs && electron tests/hydra-style.cjs && electron tests/widget-app-styles.cjs && electron tests/quota-account-preview.cjs && electron tests/app-gallery.cjs --verify --all-themes && electron tests/widget-navigation.cjs && node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/calendar-surface-electron.test.js && node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/desk-tool-surface-electron.test.js && node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/quota-surface-electron.test.js && node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/pi-status-surface-electron.test.js && node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/input-status-surface-electron.test.js
